data.title: 莲华 · 幽暗海湾万华镜倒影前的神秘低语
data.action: 静坐在退潮后泛着深紫晚霞的浅滩光滑黑曜石上，指尖悬在水面上方，红眸幽深地注视着水面泛起的万花筒光斑
data.location: 连接现世与异界、黄昏永不落幕的神秘古老海滩
data.lighting: 天边泛着不可思议的紫粉色落日余晖，海水里倒映着如同万华镜般流转的奇幻几何光斑，清冷神秘
data.mood: 神秘莫测、宿命纠缠与摄人心魄的幽暗美感
data.description: 这里的海水没有温度，波纹中流转着千百世的人生幻影。莲华拢着墨黑色的哥特蕾丝裙摆端坐在平整黑石上，苍白无暇的肌肤在紫红霞光下宛若冷玉。她指尖轻点水面，一圈圈万花筒般的彩色光纹随之荡开，朱唇微启，吐出令人迷醉的轻声叹息——「海浪也是万华镜的一面啊……沉溺在这片夏日幻梦里的人，又何尝想要醒来呢？你……也是为了窥探梦境的深处而来的吗？」
data.promptProse: Seated calmly upon a smooth black obsidian rock at the edge of an otherworldly twilight shore, Renge wears an ornate jet-black and midnight-violet gothic corset swimdress with sheer spiderweb lace ruffles and a velvet choker. Hovering one pale fingertip above shifting kaleidoscopic water reflections, she offers a haunting, faint smile under purple dusk skies.
data.animaCaption: Seated gracefully on a smooth obsidian tide rock in her black-and-violet gothic corset swimdress and velvet choker, she hovers one pale fingertip above kaleidoscopic water ripples with an enigmatic faint smile. Surreal violet-and-rose twilight paints the quiet ancient beach.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ornate jet-black and midnight-violet gothic corset swimdress with antique spiderweb lace hem ruffles and a velvet spider-lily choker.
